props.gloss_en: 'and as He was destroying, the Lord saw and relented' (I Chr 21:15) -- what did He see?
Rav: He saw Jacob our father
as it is written: 'and Jacob said when he saw them' (Gen 32:3)
as it is said: 'God will see for Himself the lamb' (Gen 22:8)
R' Yitzchak Nappacha: He saw the atonement money
as it is said: 'and you shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel...' (Ex 30:16)
R' Yochanan: He saw the Temple
as it is written: 'on the mount of the Lord He will be seen' (Gen 22:14)
R' Yaakov bar Idi and R' Shmuel bar Nachmani disagree about it: one said, He saw the atonement money
and one said, He saw the Temple
as it is said: 'as it is said this day: on the mount of the Lord He will be seen' (Gen 22:14)
